title: The separate-port option binds probe handlers to a dedicated listener and keeps user traffic clean of them
asA: operator running a Kubernetes deployment that publishes only the traffic port on the Service
iWant: probe handlers bound to a container port distinct from the traffic port when I set `probeListener.separatePort`
soThat: probes reach the pod on the kubelet-only port while the public Service never sees a probe path

acceptanceCriteria.description: When `probeListener.separatePort: <N>` is set on the Kubernetes profile, probe handlers bind to port N and no probe handler is bound on the user-traffic listener.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process configured with `probeInterface.profile: kubernetes` and `probeListener.separatePort: 9091` with a distinct user-traffic port
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the topology binds
acceptanceCriteria.then: a GET against `/live` on port 9091 returns 200, a GET against `/live` on the user-traffic port returns 404 (or the project's default not-found response), and a GET against `/ready` on the user-traffic port returns 404

acceptanceCriteria.description: The separate probe listener binds only the profile's resolved probe path set; any other path returns not-found on the probe listener.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the Kubernetes profile with `probeListener.separatePort: 9091` and a user-authored `/api/orders` route on the traffic listener
acceptanceCriteria.when: a GET against `/api/orders` is issued against port 9091
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 404 (or the profile's declared not-found), and the request is not routed to the `/api/orders` handler

acceptanceCriteria.description: The default topology remains fused (probes bind on the user-traffic listener) when `probeListener.separatePort` is unset.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a process on the Kubernetes profile with no `probeListener.separatePort` override
acceptanceCriteria.when: the process boots and the topology binds
acceptanceCriteria.then: GET `/live` on the user-traffic listener returns 200 and no additional listener is opened
